newsitem.title: CHINA: China formally announces CSRC shake-up.
newsitem.headline: China formally announces CSRC shake-up.

text.p: China formally announced on Friday that Zhou Zhengqing had taken over the reins of the stock market watchdog, the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
Zhou succeeds Zhou Daojiong, who has been removed from the his post as chairman, the Xinhua news agency said.
The report confirmed a previous statement to Reuters by the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
Zhou Zhengqing remains in his post as head of the Securities Committee of the State Council (cabinet), which sets policies for the securities industry.
Zhou Daojiong also was stripped of his job as deputy at the Securities Committee and was succeeded in that job by vice governor of the central bank Chen Yaoxian.
The brief statement by the official news agency said that Chen Dongzheng has been made deputy of the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC).
The shake-up follows top level concerns within the Chinese government over the inability of CSRC regulators to halt speculative swings in domestic share prices.
